title: Still on the Course
subtitle: A stopwatch cannot measure worth
sourceCredit: Gregory Brady · The Moth Radio Hour, “Saving Graces”

shot.title: The retreating finish
shot.direction: An exhausted athlete watches a finish banner recede in wide perspective.
shot.soundDirection: Labored footfalls, crowd murmur, watch beep softening into footsteps.

illustration.direction: A wide endurance-course view holds the exhausted father on a quiet stretch of track, torso bent slightly from fatigue and hands briefly near his thighs. His shoes are planted, one knee softened, sweat suggested sparingly. A plain distant finish banner with no lettering sits far down the perspective. A translucent dark rectangular stamp-shadow presses over the track as an inward judgment, never bearing words. The distance feels discouraging, not supernatural.

shot.title: The stamp falls
shot.direction: The FAILURE stamp descends in two rough frames, then settles over the track.
shot.soundDirection: Labored footfalls, crowd murmur, watch beep softening into footsteps.

beats.caption: I’m too slow. I’ve ruined the whole thing.
beats.speaker: ATHLETE

shot.title: Judging the clock
shot.direction: His face turns toward the clock instead of the people beside the course.
shot.soundDirection: Labored footfalls, crowd murmur, watch beep softening into footsteps.

illustration.direction: The athlete looks down at a simple wristwatch, his forearm angled naturally before his tired face, other hand resting briefly at his hip. His brow is tight and his mouth turned toward self-reproach. The track and far banner remain behind him, under the same translucent stamp-shadow. No readable watch digits, race placing or disqualifying official is shown. His ordinary fatigue and attention to time carry the scene.

shot.title: Still out there
shot.direction: A supporter calls from the edge. His gaze does not reach them immediately.
shot.soundDirection: Labored footfalls, crowd murmur, watch beep softening into footsteps.

illustration.direction: A supportive course edge appears beside the same track, suggested by a low rope and a few unindividualized distant shapes, while the athlete has just begun to turn toward an offscreen call. His shoulders remain low and his eyes have not yet found the speaker. One foot has pivoted but carries believable weight. Leave a clear gap between him and the safe edge so no spectator touches or pulls him. The course is still real and unfinished.

shot.title: A daughter’s signal
shot.direction: The daughter waves clearly and holds her place beside the course.
shot.soundDirection: Labored footfalls, crowd murmur, watch beep softening into footsteps.

illustration.direction: His daughter stands safely behind the course rope, waving one whole connected arm with an eager, concerned smile; her other hand holds the rope lightly without climbing it. The father is foreground left, head lifting from the watch toward her actual face. Keep the child's feet planted and the adult/child scale plausible. The distant finish remains small; her presence, not the banner or stopwatch, draws his focus.

shot.title: Looking up
shot.direction: His eyes leave the clock and find her face.
shot.soundDirection: Labored footfalls, crowd murmur, watch beep softening into footsteps.

shot.title: You came
shot.direction: Recognition changes his posture before it changes his pace.
shot.soundDirection: Labored footfalls, crowd murmur, watch beep softening into footsteps.

illustration.direction: The father faces his daughter across the safe course edge, lowering his watch arm, a small astonished relieved smile breaking through fatigue. His daughter lowers the wave to an encouraging open hand, looking directly back. He stands a little more upright but is still plainly tired, knees soft and shoes grounded. They do not embrace across the rope or leap into a winning sprint. The warm space between their faces is the change.

beats.caption: Then I can take one more step.
beats.speaker: ATHLETE

shot.title: One deliberate step
shot.direction: Frame the foot making one weight-bearing step; the stamp becomes transparent.
shot.soundDirection: Labored footfalls, crowd murmur, watch beep softening into footsteps.

illustration.direction: In a low but complete wide composition, the athlete takes one deliberate forward step along the course: front sole meets the track, bent knee accepts his weight, rear heel lifts naturally. His upper body remains tired yet directed, and his daughter stays visible at the safe edge encouraging him. The dark stamp-shadow has thinned almost transparent. The finish banner is still ahead; no medal, finish-line break or race-winning transformation is added.

shot.direction: He advances a modest distance toward the visible course, without an invented race-winning finish.
